failed_acs.text: DockerSandbox.create(config) returns a running container with gVisor runtime (runsc)
failed_acs.reason: FAIL: create() raises TypeError: run() got an unexpected keyword argument 'host_config'. docker_sandbox.py:89 passes host_config=host_config to the high-level containers.create(), which does not accept that kwarg (it builds host_config internally from individual kwargs). TypeErrors are not docker.errors.DockerException, so the runsc fallback (line 100) never triggers. Reproduced live against real Docker daemon.

failed_acs.text: Git commands (git status, git add, etc.) fail inside sandbox with a clear error
failed_acs.reason: CANT_VERIFY: git-blocking is enforced at the container image level (image must not include git), documented only in the EgressPolicy docstring (egress.py:26-29). No sandbox image is built or referenced, so no live container exists to confirm git returns a clear error. EgressPolicy only blocks network egress to git remotes, not local git commands.

FAIL: docker_sandbox.py:146 passes filters={'label': {key: value}} but docker-py only matches label filters given as a list of 'key=value' strings. Reproduced live: a container labeled bp_agents.sandbox.image=probe:latest was returned by docker CLI (--filter label=...) and by docker-py filters={'label': ['bp_agents.sandbox.image=probe:latest']}, but list_containers() returned []. Method is genuinely broken against the real API.

failed_acs.text: Fallback to hardened plain Docker works if gVisor unavailable
failed_acs.reason: FAIL: fallback path (docker_sandbox.py:100-106, catching docker.errors.DockerException) is unreachable for the actual failure mode. The create() failure is a TypeError (unexpected kwarg host_config), not a DockerException, so it propagates without falling back. Even had runsc been absent, the TypeError would surface first. Reproduced live: image creation with runsc config fails with TypeError, not a clean fallback.

ac_results.text: Fallback to hardened plain Docker works if gVisor unavailable
ac_results.evidence: Live: create() with runsc config raises TypeError (host_config kwarg), not DockerException, so the except docker.errors.DockerException fallback (docker_sandbox.py:100) never executes. runsc absent on host; fallback path unreachable due to the create() bug.

summary: FAIL. Lint passes, 60/60 unit tests pass, no integration tests exist. Live-system verification against a real Docker daemon exposed two genuine bugs to the packaged API: (1) create() passes host_config to the high-level containers.create() which does not accept it, raising TypeError and breaking the runsc/fallback path (AC-01/02/03/08); (2) list_containers() uses an invalid label filter format, returning [] even when matching labeled containers exist (AC-06). destroy() and is_running() work live; the egress allowlist is configurable and logged on startup (AC-07). AC-02/03/04 cannot be verified live because create() is broken and no sandbox image exists. Unit tests cover the logic but mock away the docker-py API contract, so they miss these integration failures. Fix required before approval.
